description: Implementation of an in-memory storage grain for Orleans, providing methods for reading, writing, and deleting grain state with ETag validation and logging.

classes.name: MemoryStorageGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing in-memory storage for Orleans, supporting state read/write/delete with ETag validation and detailed logging.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the state associated with a grain key, returning the stored state cast to the specified type.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes or updates the state for a grain key, updating the ETag and logging the operation.

methods.name: DeleteStateAsync
methods.description: Marks the state for a grain key as deleted by setting its value to null after ETag validation.

methods.name: NewEtag
methods.description: Generates a new unique ETag string using GUID.

methods.name: GetETagFromStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the current ETag for a given grain key from the in-memory store.

methods.name: ValidateEtag
methods.description: Validates the received ETag against the current ETag, throwing an exception on mismatch.
